name: bthome-cpp
description: Dependency-free C++17 BTHome v2 payload builder and parser. No heap, no exceptions, no RTTI. Sensors, binary sensors, events, text/raw, AES-CCM encryption and decryption with pluggable crypto backends (mbedtls and PSA adapters included). Decodes advertisements from any source - a BLE scan or a transport without a BLE stack. Pair with any BLE stack.
keywords: bthome, ble, bluetooth, advertisement, home-assistant, beacon, esp32, zephyr, arduino, sensor, decoder, receiver
